name.description: Service name; used to construct paths and variable references like /etc/$NAME, /var/lib/$NAME, etc.

user.description: User account under which the daemon runs (used in chown/chuid).

daemon.description: Path to the main daemon executable.

daemon_args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the daemon at startup.

pidfile.description: Full path to the PID file.

verbose.description: Whether to output verbose log messages (matches LSB convention; 'yes' or 'no').
